question: Which libraries and engines exist for causal discovery and downstream causal analysis, what can each do, how well maintained and how fast are they, and what should the planned claim ledger reuse versus build?

schema.name: library or engine (and version scope)
schema.interventional_data_support: whether and how interventional data or targets are used
schema.background_knowledge_support: tiers / required / forbidden edges and how enforced
schema.outputs: DAG / CPDAG / PAG / scores / bootstrap probabilities
schema.scalability_reported: reported scale or speed, with label reported / claim / second-hand / none
schema.deterministic_given_seed: yes / no / partial / unknown, with basis
schema.column_order_invariance: documented / known issue / unknown, with basis
schema.licence: licence from LICENSE file, CRAN DESCRIPTION or PyPI metadata
schema.last_release: latest version and date (PyPI, CRAN or git tag)
schema.maintainers_activity: commits on default branch since 2025-10-12 from git log of a blobless clone, unless stated
schema.python_api_quality_notes: usability notes for our Python stack

rows.name: causal-learn (upstream, PyPI 0.1.4.8)
rows.interventional_data_support: none general; CD-NOD uses a domain/time index for heterogeneous data
rows.background_knowledge_support: BackgroundKnowledge: forbidden and required edges (by node or regex pattern), tiers, forbid/allow within tier (forbid-within-tier added 2026-02); accepted by PC, FCI, CD-NOD; not by GES
rows.scalability_reported: second-hand (issue #175): GES took hours vs seconds in Tetrad on a 100-variable fMRI set; no benchmark in docs read
rows.deterministic_given_seed: yes for PC/FCI/GES with Fisher-z (no RNG in path; code reading); unknown for KCI/RCIT/FastKCI
rows.column_order_invariance: known issue, historic: issue #82 (PC graphs depend on ordering; maintainers say fixed). Our run: 0.1.4.8 showed no dependence on 24 files (project measurement). Residual risk by code reading: default uc_priority=2 resolves conflicting colliders first-come in index order
rows.maintainers_activity: 55 commits on main since 2025-10-12 (git log); 33 PyPI releases since 2021
rows.python_api_quality_notes: pure Python, numpy in / CausalGraph out; endpoint-matrix encoding is idiosyncratic; prints/progress bars by default; FCI rejects fastkci/rcit (open issue #246); stores union of separating sets per pair, which behaves like conservative PC (maintainer comment in #175)

rows.name: causal-learn fork vendored in Causal-Copilot (externals/causal-learn at a31aa7c, labelled 0.1.3.8)
algorithms: as upstream 0.1.3.8 plus BOSS, GST, CALM, FastKCI, RCIT, BatchKCI, MarkovNetwork utilities
ci_tests: FastKCI (falls back silently to KCI on ValueError)
rows.background_knowledge_support: as upstream; Causal-Copilot's LLM writes forbidden/required/tiers JSON from user text
rows.scalability_reported: none reported; joblib parallel skeleton with n_jobs=4 default
rows.deterministic_given_seed: yes for Fisher-z path in stable mode (parallel results merged after each depth; code reading)
rows.column_order_invariance: known issue: our measurement found PC output depends on column order in 21 of 24 files. Mechanism by code reading: skeleton (SkeletonDiscovery.py L188-197) and FCI's FAS (FAS.py L193-197) build node_pairs only for x<y and test subsets of adj(x)\{y} only, never adj(y)\{x}
rows.licence: MIT (causal-learn LICENSE kept); other vendored code in externals/ ships without its own licence files
rows.last_release: no release; tree snapshot dated 2026-05-15 (commit a31aa7c)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: silently diverges from PyPI 0.1.3.8 in about 25 files (diff -rq); version label is misleading; a fork must be pinned by hash, not by version string

rows.name: Tetrad (tetrad-lib, GUI)
algorithms: 49 listed in manual for 7.6.9: PC, PC-Max, CPC, FCI, RFCI, FCI-IOD, GFCI, BOSS, BOSS-FCI, GRaSP, GRaSP-FCI, SP, SP-FCI, FGES, LV-Heuristic, IMaGES, IMaGES-BOSS, FCIT, DirectLiNGAM, ICA-LiNGAM, FASK, CAM, DAGMA, CD-NOD, PCMCI, CCD, StabilitySelection, StARS, CStaR, latent clustering (FOFC, FTFC, BPC, TSC, GIN) ...
rows.interventional_data_support: multi-dataset search (IMaGES, IMaGES-BOSS, FCI-IOD); CD-NOD for distribution shift; no intervention-target model found in manual list
rows.background_knowledge_support: Knowledge box: tiers, forbidden edges, required edges; enforced by searches that support knowledge; tiers auto-created for time lags
outputs: bootstrap edge-type frequencies incl. circle marks and no-edge
rows.deterministic_given_seed: partial: bootstrap seed settable (manual); 2026-07-31 commit investigated nondeterminism in BFCI/GFCI and named global RNG use as a source
rows.column_order_invariance: PC is PC-Stable (maintainer, issue #175); otherwise unknown
rows.maintainers_activity: 2,051 commits on default branch since 2025-10-12 (git log)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: Python only through py-tetrad (JPype) or causal-cmd; very active but high churn in FCI/PAG rules (7.6.6-7.6.10 notes, 2026-09 R4 commit)

rows.name: py-tetrad / rpy-tetrad
rows.language: Python and R wrappers over Java (JPype / reticulate)
rows.background_knowledge_support: as Tetrad (not documented on README read)
outputs: as Tetrad; graph and data translation helpers
rows.licence: MIT for the wrapper; it calls GPL-3.0 Tetrad
rows.last_release: tag v0.2.0 (2023-10-31); install from git, not PyPI
rows.python_api_quality_notes: needs JDK 21+ and Python 3.12+; README asks users to 'bear with us'; no PyPI package

rows.name: causal-cmd
rows.background_knowledge_support: knowledge files (not documented on README read)
rows.licence: GPL per pom.xml (no LICENSE file at root)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: subprocess boundary; an older Python client (py-causal) had an unresolved run-to-run nondeterminism report (2019)

rows.name: pcalg
rows.interventional_data_support: yes: gies and simy (interventional Markov equivalence); opt.target for experiment choice
rows.background_knowledge_support: fixedGaps / fixedEdges in pc; addBgKnowledge on CPDAG/PDAG
rows.scalability_reported: none read; numCores option for skeleton
rows.deterministic_given_seed: yes for pc with Fisher-z (no RNG; u2pd='rand' uses RNG)
rows.column_order_invariance: documented: skel.method='stable' is order-independent; conservative or maj.rule with solve.confl=TRUE gives fully order-independent output (manual); Colombo & Maathuis 2014
rows.last_release: 2.7-12 (2024-09-13) per cran.r-universe.dev DESCRIPTION; cran.r-project.org index page as fetched showed 2.7-11 (2024-02-12), likely stale
rows.maintainers_activity: no public git history read; one CRAN release in the last 24 months
rows.python_api_quality_notes: R only; reachable from Python via rpy2 or subprocess (CDT wraps it)

rows.name: bnlearn (R)
rows.interventional_data_support: yes for scoring: modified Bayesian Dirichlet score for mixed interventional and observational data
outputs: boot.strength: arc strength and direction given presence (per prior note cluster3, not re-read)
rows.column_order_invariance: unknown for bnlearn itself; second-hand: Kitson & Constantinou report column order moves hill-climbing F1 by 0.412 on average, PC-Stable by 0.036 (cluster8 note)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: R only; note the unrelated Python package 'bnlearn' (erdogant) on PyPI

rows.name: gCastle (Huawei Noah's Ark)
rows.background_knowledge_support: PrioriKnowledge (required/forbidden) accepted by PC and TTPM (code grep)
rows.deterministic_given_seed: yes for PC with Fisher-z (code reading); unknown for gradient methods
rows.column_order_invariance: known issue by code reading: default variant='original'; in 'original' and 'stable' the loop over combinations(nodes,2) tests only subsets of adj(i)\{j} for i<j (pc.py L388-401, v1.0.4); only 'parallel' tests both sides
rows.maintainers_activity: 2 commits under gcastle/ since 2025-10-12 (incl. 2026-05-29 fix: MetricsDAG TPR > 1.0 with bidirectional edges)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: numpy in / matrix out; metrics bug fixed only in 2026; low activity

rows.name: CDT (Causal Discovery Toolbox)
algorithms: pairwise: ANM, IGCI, RCC, NCC, Jarfo, CDS, RECI
rows.licence: MIT (repo LICENSE.md); PyPI metadata says Apache 2.0 - conflict; R backends are GPL
rows.python_api_quality_notes: effectively unmaintained; Docker images target Python 3.6

rows.name: DoWhy (PyWhy)
rows.interventional_data_support: no discovery from interventional data; simulates interventions on a given graph
outputs: falsify_graph: LMC violations vs random-graph baseline
rows.deterministic_given_seed: partial: per-simulation seed fix in DataSubsetRefuter (2026-06)
rows.column_order_invariance: not applicable (no discovery); unknown for falsify permutation baseline
rows.python_api_quality_notes: mature, widely used; needs a full DAG (no CPDAG/PAG identification found in pages read)

rows.name: dodiscover (PyWhy)
rows.background_knowledge_support: Context with included/excluded edges, skeleton phase only (issue #46 on orientation phase unresolved)
rows.last_release: no PyPI release ('doesn't work until we make an official release')
rows.python_api_quality_notes: best typed design in the PyWhy stack (Context object) but self-labelled experimental and dormant

rows.name: pywhy-graphs
rows.python_api_quality_notes: self-labelled experimental; requires Python <3.12 per PyPI

rows.name: pywhy-stats
rows.interventional_data_support: conditional k-sample tests usable for interventional contrasts
rows.python_api_quality_notes: requires Python <3.11 per PyPI; dormant

rows.name: pywhy-llm
rows.background_knowledge_support: produces suggested edges, confounders, backdoor/IV sets from an LLM
rows.deterministic_given_seed: no (LLM calls; no seed or cache documented)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: self-labelled experimental; examples use 'gpt-4'; no per-edge provenance or calibration

rows.name: EconML
rows.interventional_data_support: n/a (effect estimation from observational data with stated adjustment/IV)
rows.background_knowledge_support: user supplies X, W, Z roles
rows.python_api_quality_notes: mature; downstream of the graph, not a discovery engine

rows.name: causica / DECI (Microsoft)
algorithms: DECI (Rhino and DDECI removed in refactor)
rows.interventional_data_support: interventional data used for evaluation (datasets/interventional_data.py); learning from observational data
rows.maintainers_activity: 3 commits since 2025-10-12; 41 commits total after refactor
rows.python_api_quality_notes: Python 3.10 only per PyPI; GPU-oriented deep model

rows.name: Ananke
algorithms: identification and semiparametric estimation in ADMGs
rows.python_api_quality_notes: no structure learning

rows.name: CausalNex (McKinsey)
algorithms: NOTEARS-based structure learning (not named on page read)
rows.maintainers_activity: end of life 2026-06-24 per README; 9 commits since 2025-10-12 (final release housekeeping)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: discontinued; do not adopt

rows.name: Tigramite
rows.deterministic_given_seed: seed handling fixes 2021/2023 (commit log); permutation tests need seeds
rows.column_order_invariance: unknown; 2025-08 commit added a preferred tie order for LPCMCI
rows.python_api_quality_notes: mature; time series only (out of our iid slice)

rows.name: lingam (cdt15)
ci_tests: independence measures: pwling, kernel, pwling_fast (GPU via culingam)
rows.background_knowledge_support: prior_knowledge matrix (0 no path, 1 path, -1 unknown), hard or soft
rows.python_api_quality_notes: clean sklearn-style API; prior knowledge is about directed paths, which matches order evidence

rows.name: benchpress
algorithms: wraps algorithms from BDgraph, BiDAG, bnlearn, causal-learn, gCastle, GOBNILP, pcalg, r.blip, scikit-learn, TETRAD, trilearn (paper); pyAgrum, MVPC, tpc in news
rows.python_api_quality_notes: JSON-configured; a harness, not an engine

rows.name: AVICI
rows.scalability_reported: reported (DOM-11): forward pass a few seconds on CPU; trained on up to 100 nodes
rows.python_api_quality_notes: simple API; weights on HF

rows.name: SDCD
rows.interventional_data_support: yes: designed for labelled interventional data
rows.scalability_reported: reported: 'can scale to thousands of variables' (abstract)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: research code; preprint

rows.name: DAGMA
rows.scalability_reported: claim (README): faster than NOTEARS and GOLEM; no numbers
rows.column_order_invariance: unknown; continuous methods are exposed to varsortability (Reisach et al.)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: small, readable

rows.name: NOTEARS (reference implementation)
rows.column_order_invariance: unknown; varsortability: some continuous methods fail on standardized data (Reisach et al.)
rows.maintainers_activity: 1 commit since 2025-10-12; README points to dagrad
rows.python_api_quality_notes: reference code only; copies also inside gCastle, CausalNex, Causal-Copilot externals

rows.name: cuPC
rows.scalability_reported: reported (README/abstract): average 500x (cuPC-E) and 1300x (cuPC-S) over serial CPU; one dataset from more than 11 hours to about 4 seconds
rows.python_api_quality_notes: R + nvcc build; NVIDIA only

rows.name: gpucsl
rows.column_order_invariance: documented: PC-stable; README says orientation conflicts resolved to match pcalg
rows.python_api_quality_notes: Linux + NVIDIA + CUDA 11.2 images; used by Causal-Copilot for GPU PC

rows.name: culingam (AcceleratedLiNGAM)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: used through lingam measure='pwling_fast'

rows.name: XGES
rows.scalability_reported: reported (abstract): 10 times faster than GES; C++ at least about 10x faster than its Python version (README)
rows.licence: none found (no LICENSE file; PyPI license empty)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: used by Causal-Copilot; licence blocks redistribution

rows.name: ges / gies (Gamella)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: small pure-Python reference implementations; permissive GIES alternative to pcalg

rows.name: graphical_models / graphical_model_learning (Uhler lab, ex-causaldag)
algorithms: graph classes (DAG, PDAG, MAG, PAG, interventions); learning algorithms in graphical_model_learning not read
rows.python_api_quality_notes: alpha, dormant

rows.name: pgmpy
rows.interventional_data_support: interventional distributions on a given model
rows.deterministic_given_seed: partial: GES made deterministic across Python hash seeds on 2026-04-09 (commit)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: very active; LLM orientation via litellm (default gemini-1.5-flash); no per-edge provenance documented

rows.name: gadjid
rows.language: Rust core with Python and R bindings
rows.scalability_reported: claim (README): 'orders of magnitude faster' than SID; no numbers
rows.python_api_quality_notes: the only Rust engine found that is relevant; evaluation, not discovery

rows.name: why-rs / why_rs
rows.python_api_quality_notes: hobby-scale crate; not a candidate

rows.name: deep_causality_discovery
rows.python_api_quality_notes: not graph discovery in our sense

rows.name: Causal-Copilot wrappers (causal_discovery/wrappers, LLM layer)
algorithms: PC, PC-parallel, FCI, CDNOD, GES, FGES, XGES, GRaSP, DirectLiNGAM, ICALiNGAM, VARLiNGAM, NOTEARS (linear/nonlinear), NTS-NOTEARS, DYNOTEARS, GOLEM, CORL, CALM, PCMCI, Granger, Markov-blanket methods (pyCausalFS), Hybrid
rows.background_knowledge_support: LLM converts user text to forbidden/required/tiers JSON (PC.json); GPU path drops knowledge
rows.column_order_invariance: known issue via vendored fork (see that row)
rows.python_api_quality_notes: wrapper default depth=4 while PC.json advises -1; per-algorithm LLM prompts; no per-edge provenance
